title: MiG-31 Firefox (film)
intro: The MiG-31 Firefox is the fictional Soviet stealth fighter of the film Firefox (1982), able to fly at six times the speed of sound. Its weapons are fired by thought through the pilot's helmet. The pilot sits alone and flies with a normal stick and throttle while the helmet fires the weapons.

areas.name: Canopy and helmet
areas.text: The thought-control helmet and the canopy.

panels.name: Thought-control helmet
panels.text: A helmet linked to the weapons that reads the pilot's thoughts.
panels.context: It is the Firefox's most famous feature in the film.

controls.name: Thought-control helmet
controls.text: The helmet reads the pilot's thoughts and fires the weapons when the pilot thinks the command. The commands must be thought in Russian.
controls.context: In the film this is a problem for the American pilot, who has to remember to think in Russian.

controls.name: Rear defence pod
controls.text: A rear-firing missile, fired by thought.
controls.context: It is used against an enemy behind the fighter in the final duel of the film.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The canopy over the single seat of the Firefox.
panels.context: The pilot looks out through it.

controls.name: Canopy
controls.text: The clear canopy over the single seat of the Firefox.
controls.context: It covers the pilot during flight at very high speed.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: Displays for flying and for the weapons in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They show speed, height, targets and weapons.

controls.name: Flight displays
controls.text: Displays show the speed and the altitude (the height).
controls.context: At six times the speed of sound the pilot watches them closely.

controls.name: Weapons display
controls.text: A display shows the targets and the weapons.
controls.context: It shows the pilot what the thought-controlled weapons can attack.

areas.name: Stick and throttle
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Control stick
panels.text: The centre stick in front of the Firefox pilot.
panels.context: It steers the fighter in every direction.

controls.name: Control stick
controls.text: Pushing the stick forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; moving it left or right rolls the fighter.
controls.context: The pilot flies with the stick while the weapons follow his thoughts.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: The throttle at the Firefox pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It sets how hard the engines push.

controls.name: Throttle
controls.text: Pushing the throttle forward gives the engines more thrust; pulling it back gives less.
controls.context: It controls the speed of the very fast fighter.
